这是一个基于 Flux 的工作流程，只需单击一下即可将照片转换为个性化插图和头像。结合FLUX｜祈2025、祝福2025肖像-麒麟LoRA，轻松生成新年主题插画。只需上传照片，输入所需的背景提示，并集成样式LoRA即可创建风格化的头像。

😊推荐LoRA：

FLUX｜2025年祝福，农历新年肖像-麒麟座

此工作流程支持有效的图像控制、无缝 LoRA 风格混合以及用于单独替换的灵活的角色背景分离。

尝试一下并随时分享您的结果！ 😊

特点：

  1. 生成新年主题插图

  • 上传一张真实照片，并将其与我们定制训练的 LoRA: FLUXBlessings for 2025 - Monoceros 结合起来，只需单击一下即可转换为节日插图。

  1. 字符的图像到图像和背景的文本到图像

  • 实现角色与背景的完美融合。

  1. 保留角色身份和姿势

  • 保持原始照片的主要特征和姿势。

  1. 独立替换角色或背景

  • 灵活地交换任一元素以满足您的需求。

  1. 使用不同的 LoRA 改变风格

  • 通过切换 LoRA 轻松改变最终的插图风格。

使用方法：

  1. 上传照片

  • 使用最多 3 个人的清晰、自然的照片以获得最佳效果。

  1. 选择 LoRA 型号

  • 推荐：FLUX｜新年头像-麒麟座LoRA营造令人惊叹的节日氛围！

  1. 复制或编写背景提示

  • 使用左侧提供的预设背景提示模板或在红色输入框中编写自己的背景提示模板。

  1. 产生！

❤️推荐参数❤️

（工作流程包括预配置的设置。除非另有说明，否则无需进行调整。）

  • 基本型号：通量

  • 图像分辨率：1024x1344（垂直肖像效果最好！）

  • 步骤：25–30

  • 其他参数：默认设置可确保与原始照片最相似。

✨ 专业提示：

  • 如果您想要与原始照片不同的更加风格化的结果，请增加图像中的降噪强度图像融合组。

  • 为了让角色的外观有更多变化，请提高降噪强度角色生成组。

注意事项：

  • 在线生成：如果在线出现错误，请尝试下载工作流程本地使用。

  • 运气因素：生成时可能需要多次尝试。

  • 故障排除结果：如果结果不满意，请尝试更改照片。避免爆头并确保照片包含全身或半身姿势，以获得更好的稳定性。

免责声明：
模型仅供学习和参考之用。未经授权，不得用于商业用途。

感谢您的喜欢、下载和关注！请分享您的结果并发表评论！ 🎉

o.en:
This is a Flux-based workflow that allows you to transform photos into personalized illustrations and avatars in a single click. By combining the FLUX｜pray for 2025 , Blessings for 2025 Portrait-Monoceros LoRA, you can generate New Year-themed illustrations effortlessly. Simply upload a photo, input the desired background prompts, and integrate a style LoRA to create stylized avatars.

😊Recommended LoRA:

FLUX｜Blessings for 2025 , Lunar New Year Portrait-Monoceros

This workflow supports effective image control, seamless LoRA style blending, and flexible character-background separation for individual replacements.

Give it a try and feel free to share your results! 😊

Features:

  1. Generate New Year-themed illustrations

  • Upload a real-life photo and combine it with our custom-trained LoRA: FLUXBlessings for 2025 - Monoceros, for a single-click transformation into a festive illustration.

  1. Image-to-Image for characters and Text-to-Image for backgrounds

  • Achieve perfect character-background fusion.

  1. Preserve character identity and pose

  • Maintain the key features and pose of the original photo.

  1. Independently replace characters or backgrounds

  • Flexibly swap either element to suit your needs.

  1. Change styles with different LoRAs

  • Easily alter the final illustration style by switching LoRAs.

How to Use:

  1. Upload a photo

  • Use a clear, natural photo with up to 3 people for optimal results.

  1. Select a LoRA model

  • Recommended:FLUX｜New Year Avatar - Monoceros LoRAfor amazing festive vibes!

  1. Copy or write prompts for the background

  • Use the preset background prompt templates provided on the left or write your own in the red input box.

  1. Generate!

❤️ Recommended Parameters ❤️

(The workflow includes preconfigured settings. No adjustments are necessary unless otherwise stated.)

  • Base Model:Flux

  • Image Resolution:1024x1344 (Vertical portraits work best!)

  • Steps:25–30

  • Other Parameters:Default settings ensure the best resemblance to the original photo.

✨ Pro Tip:

  • If you'd like a more stylized result that diverges from the original photo, increase the denoise strength in theImage Fusiongroup.

  • To allow more variations in the character’s appearance, raise the denoise strength in theCharacter Generationgroup.

Notes:

  • Online Generation: If errors occur online, try downloading the workflow for local use.

  • Luck Factor: Multiple attempts may be needed when generating.

  • Troubleshooting Results: If the results are unsatisfactory, try changing the photo. Avoid headshots and ensure photos include full-body or half-body poses for better stability.

Disclaimer:
Models are for learning and reference purposes only. Commercial use is not allowed without authorization.

Thank you for your likes, downloads, and follows! Please share your results and leave comments! 🎉
